name: shared_nav
description: The Shared section's pages (list, folder, album, photo): back returns to the list. Reached by: app go_to shared.

actions.name: back
actions.description: Back to the Shared list from what is open, a folder at any depth included (as its "Shared" breadcrumb does). Not on the list

page.description: The page shown: the list (screen shared_list), a shared folder (screen shared), an album or a photo

id.description: The folder, album or photo open; null on the list

name.description: The album or photo's name; null on the list and in a folder (its state has the name)
